description: This file contains conversion functions and registration logic for resource-related API objects in Kubernetes, specifically for the v1beta1 version. It includes functions to convert between v1beta1 and internal resource representations, handle field label conversions, and manage resource device requests and specifications.

methods.name: addConversionFuncs
methods.description: Registers conversion functions and field label conversion for ResourceSlice kind in the runtime scheme.

methods.name: Convert_v1beta1_DeviceRequest_To_resource_DeviceRequest
methods.description: Converts a v1beta1 DeviceRequest to internal resource DeviceRequest, including handling of the 'Exactly' field based on main request fields.

methods.name: hasAnyMainRequestFieldsSet
methods.description: Checks if any main fields of a DeviceRequest are set, indicating the need to create an 'Exactly' request.

methods.name: Convert_resource_DeviceRequest_To_v1beta1_DeviceRequest
methods.description: Converts an internal resource DeviceRequest to v1beta1, including populating the 'Exactly' field if present.

methods.name: Convert_v1beta1_ResourceSliceSpec_To_resource_ResourceSliceSpec
methods.description: Converts v1beta1 ResourceSliceSpec to internal ResourceSliceSpec, handling NodeName and AllNodes fields.

methods.name: Convert_resource_ResourceSliceSpec_To_v1beta1_ResourceSliceSpec
methods.description: Converts internal ResourceSliceSpec to v1beta1, handling NodeName and AllNodes fields.

methods.name: Convert_v1beta1_Device_To_resource_Device
methods.description: Converts v1beta1 Device to internal resource Device, including attributes, capacity, and other nested fields.

methods.name: Convert_resource_Device_To_v1beta1_Device
methods.description: Converts internal resource Device to v1beta1 Device, including attributes, capacity, and nested fields.
